The petitioner -- Raman Goyal has filed the instant petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in FIR No.88, dated 25.04.2022 registered under Section 376-D of Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of POCSO registered at Police Station Lambi, District Sri
The facts of the case are that the prosecutrix gave her statement to the police that she is about 16 years of age and was studying in 10 Class.
She purchased a mobile phone on installment from Raman Goyal who is running a mobile phone shop.
Due to poverty she failed to pay the installment.
Raman Goyal taking advantage of this fact called her at his shop on 12.04.2022 at about 1 o'clock and he developed physical relations with her against her wishes.
She was threatened not to disclose this fact to anybody.
She was again called on 24.03.2022 at Narwana where he came along with his friend Lakhvir Singh.
She was told to sit in the car SANDEEP
thereafter they went towards Bathinda Thermal plant where Raman Goyal got down from the Car and Lakhvir Singh took her to Sirsa where they went to Hotel and he again raped her against her wishes.
She was brought at Bus stand Bathinda and she returned home.
She disclosed about the occurrence to her sister and ultimately she was taken to C.H.C. Lambi and the matter was reported to the police.
Learned counsel for the petitioner argued that the allegations levelled against him are false.
He is in custody since long.
All the witnesses have failed to support the prosecution version before the trial Court.
He is ready to abide by the terms of bail order.
It is prayed that his regular bail application may be allowed.
The bail application is opposed by the counsel representing the State.
It is argued that there are specific serious allegations against the petitioner.
The victim is a minor.
The trial of this case may take some time.

The counsel for the petitioner has placed on record the statement of victim recorded as PW-1, Annexure P-3, statement of her uncle PW-2 and statement of her elder sister PW-3, Annexure P-4 and P-5 and all of them were declared hostile.
They did not support the prosecution version.
The rest of the prosecution evidence is yet to be recorded.

Therefore, considering the aforesaid facts, without expressing my mind on the merits of the case, the regular bail application filed by Raman Goyal is allowed and he is ordered to be released on bail to the satisfaction of trial Court/Duty Judge.
The petition is disposed of.
